column1: # lcp_sync.tsv -- the CURATED list of names to push into the Ghidra project.
# Read by ghidra/LcpSyncNames.java, driven by tools/sync_ghidra_names.sh.
# It lived in ~/ghidra_scripts until 2026-09-07, i.e. outside version
# control, which is the same hazard that made the verify list drift.
#   A <TAB> 0xADDRESS <TAB> port_name    rename the primary label there
#   F <TAB> 0xADDRESS <TAB> port_name    rename the function there
#   D <TAB> ghidra_name <TAB> port_name  rename by name (historical)
# Ghidra address = link address + 0x10000; for BSS take the link address
# This list is CURATED, not generated, and that is deliberate.  The
# generated tools/gen_ghidra_verify.py list names every port symbol, and
# pushing all 694 would overwrite the descriptive names Ghidra's own
# analysis carries for the globals the map has never covered
# (defProgMap is `midi_channel_volume` there).  Confirming one of those is
# research, not a mechanical push -- see docs/ghidra_globals_map.md.  Add a row
# here only once the pairing is established.
# Truncation repairs, found by the generated verify on 2026-09-07: an
# earlier sync pushed lcp_sym.68k's 8-character LINKAGE names, the same
# Labels Ghidra never created, because nothing in the image references
# these cells (2026-09-07).  All four are DATA, whose segment is
# byte-identical to the reference, so the addresses are lcp_sym.68k's
# own and involve no inference -- unlike altScreen, whose base is only
# known from a +511 reference, which is why it is NOT in this list.
# altScreen (2026-09-07).  This one is the PORT'S model, not a fact
# recovered from the image: altScreen is referenced only at +511 through
# the align-up constant, and that constant sits inside a relocated
# longword, so `base+0x1FF` and `base-1+0x200` store the same value and
# the binary cannot tell them apart (reloc_audit category E).  0x2c867
# is what source/sprites.c and parts/renderFrame.c declare today.  See the
# note in CLAUDE.md: three independent indications point at 0x2c866
# instead, and if the port ever moves, the generated verify list moves
# with it and a sync corrects this label.
